messages:
sam (AE): Skyline procurement sent an RFI asking for a POC cost breakdown, quantization effects, and a request to postpone invoicing until prod. can we triage?
anya (SE): yes. quick checklist i noted: target QPS/latency, per-token cost estimates for FP16/int8/int4, and sample accuracy deltas. i can run their 2000-prompt set.
vik (SalesEng): deployment preference? Private or Dedicated changes pricing and infra diagram.
sam (AE): they want Private (VPC + strict data residency). also asked if we support customer HSM and a 60-90 day invoice hold.
rachel (Legal): standard play: either 20% deposit or a signed 12-month committed spend with 60-day deferral. i'll draft two options for the RFI.
anya (SE): rough quant table (use as placeholder; i'll provide dataset results in 48h):
```
Model | FP16 perf | int8 perf | int4 perf | est cost delta | est acc delta
7B    | 1.0       | 0.6      | 0.38     | -25% / -52%    | -1% / -3.5%
13B   | 1.0       | 0.66     | 0.44     | -23% / -46%    | -1.2% / -4%
```
include note: numbers vary by prompt/task.
vik (SalesEng): customer needs a one-page capability matrix for procurement. i'll assemble: deployment modes, KMS/HSM (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, PKCS#11), quant profiles, SLAs, and rollback policy.
sam (AE): they also want explicit rollback language if quality gates fail post-quant rollout.
rachel (Legal): fallback clause: automated canary + immediate traffic shift to FP16 variant if regression > threshold. include monitoring and rollback window (48h).
ops-bot: Reminder: create POC ticket in Jira. Template: https://redwood-internal/ops/poc-template
anya (SE): action items: 1) run Skyline sample eval (48h). 2) vik to draft capability matrix PDF. 3) sam to open Jira and capture commercial deferral ask. 4) rachel to attach legal options.
sam (AE): thanks team — i'll open REDW-4999 and attach the RFI doc. will share procurement contact. :thumbsup:
